explanation: The vulnerable constructor generates a per-job HMAC secret and stores it in training-job environment variables (REMOTE_FUNCTION_SECRET_KEY), which are exposed by the DescribeTrainingJob API. This allows an attacker with those permissions to extract the key, forge signed serialized payloads, and achieve arbitrary code execution. It is a real cryptographic-secret exposure within the target taxonomy (CRYPTO-011/CWE-256), even though the candidate mislabels it as CWE-295/CRYPTO-010.
finding: [CRYPTO-011] HMAC secret key REMOTE_FUNCTION_SECRET_KEY is stored in job environment variables, exposing it via DescribeTrainingJob and enabling payload forgery (CWE-256).
